subject.title: fix(ui): keep Codex commentary visible after runs

question: Should this PR make stored Codex commentary visible by default for existing or unset Control UI preference profiles, rather than preserve the prior opt-in visibility behavior?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a persisted and synchronized UI preference default; source-level tests cannot determine whether that upgrade behavior is the intended product contract.

options.title: Preserve existing default
options.body: Keep durable commentary storage but retain hidden-by-default behavior unless a user explicitly enables commentary visibility.

options.title: Adopt visible-by-default
options.body: Accept the changed default and document the intentional upgrade behavior with focused coverage for existing unset profiles.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing default
recommendation.body: Keep durable commentary storage but retain hidden-by-default behavior unless a user explicitly enables commentary visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The current change author is the only concrete routing candidate in the supplied review context for the proposed preference semantics.
